Hi Elise / Tom — great to meet today. A quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Goal: validate integration latency and cost under expected query pattern (search + chat flows).
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for search demo traffic; cost targets TBD after initial 48-hour run.
- Next technical touchpoint: short rack-through with your infra lead to validate connectivity and sample traffic (30–45 min).

I attached a mutual action playbook that maps required activities, suggested owners, and target dates. Can you please confirm the owners for each row and whether the proposed timelines look realistic from your side? If anything needs to shift, tell us who should own the item and we'll update.

Attachment: [Brightora_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1.2 MB)]

Proposed owners (from our notes):
- Executive sponsor: Elise Turner
- Product lead: Tom Hsu
- Technical owner (integration): TBD — recommended: your infra/ops lead

Proposed initial milestones (week numbers relative to kickoff in the sheet). If you prefer, paste owners inline and I’ll update the source doc.

Thanks — I’ll wait to lock owners before scheduling the infra touchpoint.

Best,
